title: OTPNet: ODE-inspired Tuning-free Proximal Network for Remote Sensing Image Fusion

layout.note: Three grey rectangular panels: a short, wide (a) at top-left with (c) below it, and a tall (b) filling the right half; (b) holds ten blue-outlined equation boxes in two columns, left observation and back-projection boxes and right problem and update boxes, with arrows converging on a central box.

lesson: For algorithm-unrolling work, show the same update three times (as the physical model, as boxed equations in two mirrored branches that converge on the update, and as a network of labelled images joined by sum and difference nodes) using identical symbols so each image maps to an equation.
